Independent and applied work alongside the dissertation research.

## Strategy Lab {.unnumbered}

*In development*

A platform for constructing, backtesting, and comparing custom investment strategies against point-in-time market data — including multi-way portfolio sorts (5×5, 10×10) in the style of academic asset-pricing methodology — paired with financial-education and risk-profiling tools.

## Analog Forecasting Backtest {.unnumbered}

A short-horizon return-forecasting framework applying z-score standardized pattern matching and RMSE similarity to CRSP daily return data.
